verdict: no prior art found, within the searched corpus, for a ROLE-ASSIGNED token layout in generative recommendation: a dedicated SID level whose entries carry a behaviour / collaborative factor instead of the residual's remainder. HRQ and HiHPQ keep the residual hierarchy's meaning at every level; the semantic-plus-collaborative works (CoST, Cross-Stage Decoupling) mix the two signals but not as a dedicated level with a per-level role.

closest_neighbours.difference: every level is a residual step on the factorised codebooks; the level's MEANING is never reassigned
a Mobius residual chain; still a residual
mixes semantic and collaborative signal in the SID, but not by giving a level a different role

the_operator_as_designed: Three tokens, three 256-entry codebooks, 32 dimensions -- the frozen capacity. Level 0 and level 1 quantise the content in the product-hyperbolic geometry (the approved candidate's role-supervised level-0 assignment); level 2 does NOT quantise the residual's remainder; it quantises the item's behaviour factor (its position in the transition graph, the same signal the role supervision computes). The SID then carries content twice and behaviour once, which is exactly what Stage3 needs and what the residual chain fails to provide (92.08% of the (L1,L2) cells already determine the residual's L3 token).
what_it_must_prove: the capacity is unchanged: three levels, 256 entries each, 32 dimensions
the level-2 token is NOT determined by the (L1,L2) cell (the obstruction's own ratio must exceed 1, or the distinct-code count per cell must exceed 1 by construction)
the SID export still inverts (the three tokens map to one item)
the mechanism is not a capacity change dressed as a role change
